title: Keybind UI Bound
description: This mod adds a keybind for the keybindings UI in minecraft.
body:
Adds a keybind to open the minecraft keybindings UI. I find myself changing keybinds often, so a keybind to access the UI makes it easier. The default key is `k`, but you can change this.

If you have any ideas or suggetions you can share through github. If you encounter any issues report them through the issues link.
